video_summary.overall_goal: Open app menu and interact with backup/restore options, then return to main screen
video_summary.description: User taps menu button in Baker's Percentage Calculator app, menu opens showing Import Recipe, Backup Recipes, Restore Recipes options. Menu is dismissed and file browser appears showing Downloads folder with various APK files. After browsing, user returns to main calculator screen with backup completion toast visible.
